topics.title: Tax filing workaround via aunt Sveta

claims.text: Paying 500 UAH to aunt Sveta allowed correction of declaration errors and avoided larger penalties.
The inspector previously approved declarations without review for 1.5 years and was later reprimanded.
Re‑filing after the aunt's help cost about 1 000 UAH instead of the full fines.
Mistakes often stem from mixing up columns and subtraction signs rather than tax calculation formulas.
The calculator they use works only with a Ukrainian‑currency (UAH) FOP; other currencies require manual conversion based on the day‑of‑deposit rate.
No domain has been bought yet.
Someone suggested buying a calculator first, then using the money for a domain.
One participant opposes buying a domain, calling it an unnecessary expense.
Another participant describes the domain as a “raw thing” that won’t evaporate even in heat.
Web platforms are the simplest but significantly less profitable than Android/iOS.
SEO performance is poor; a site on the 10th Google page gets virtually no traffic.
There is no external traffic from Instagram/Threads and no contextual ads.
User retention is near zero because a paywall appears within the first 10 seconds, before the product can demonstrate value.
Conversion is assumed to be zero; the product does not simplify anything or integrate with banks or tax cabinets.
A fast delivery schedule (< 1 week from zero to release) is desirable.
Flutter was used as the cross‑platform stack in the referenced successful case.

topics.title: Bundle with password stored in local storage and security concerns

claims.text: The only password is stored in local storage as a 100 % discount promo code.
There is speculation that the password can be found by searching the source code.
Responses suggest the price of 299 UAH was not actually paid, implying the bundle may be a scam.
The product is positioned as a “local‑first” app where USD/UAH rates refresh every 5 minutes and calculations happen instantly in the browser.
A “free vibe‑code” project description emphasizes that the bundle’s value is limited to the password stored locally.

decisions.text: Adopt Flutter as the cross‑platform development stack to achieve sub‑week delivery.
Design the app as a local‑first web application with client‑side calculations and a USD/UAH exchange rate that updates every 5 minutes.
Choose not to purchase a domain at this stage, citing it as an unnecessary expense.

openQuestions.text: Is the source code publicly accessible enough to locate the stored password?
Is there a market of at least ten users willing to pay 299 UAH for the product?
